scripted_lines.text: Bellwether Field Office. The Harrows are clear. Find what stayed behind. Call when you need me.
scripted_lines.delivery: human protective operator; fear rises only with danger

scripted_lines.text: Check your instruments. Read the family notes. Find a hiding place before you need one.
scripted_lines.delivery: human protective operator; fear rises only with danger

scripted_lines.text: Start with the rooms they used most. Follow the meter. An echo is not always the source.
scripted_lines.delivery: human protective operator; fear rises only with danger

scripted_lines.text: Look at what the family left behind. Ultraviolet may show you what they could not see.
scripted_lines.delivery: human protective operator; fear rises only with danger

scripted_lines.text: The recorder needs a quiet room. Ask once, then listen.
scripted_lines.delivery: human protective operator; fear rises only with danger

scripted_lines.text: That is not interference. Find cover. Light off. Stay quiet.
scripted_lines.delivery: human protective operator; fear rises only with danger

scripted_lines.text: I can hear the rain again. Come back to the van.
scripted_lines.delivery: human protective operator; fear rises only with danger

scripted_lines.text: The line is clear. You did it. We are going home.
scripted_lines.delivery: human protective operator; fear rises only with danger

scripted_lines.text: Her chair. Do not put it away. Keep the house warm.
scripted_lines.delivery: fragile close whisper; grief and accusation

scripted_lines.text: You left her downstairs.
scripted_lines.delivery: fragile close whisper; grief and accusation

scripted_lines.text: Keep it quiet. Let the last note end.
scripted_lines.delivery: human protective operator; fear rises only with danger

scripted_lines.text: I begged for a night that would never end. Something under the stones said yes.
scripted_lines.delivery: intimate controlled menace

scripted_lines.text: The steward hid them. Faithful fool. He thought I would forget.
scripted_lines.delivery: intimate controlled menace

scripted_lines.text: Silver, cold, in the dark. Where the dead keep what they cannot spend.
scripted_lines.delivery: intimate controlled menace

scripted_lines.text: A hilt raised to the stars. The wanderer's socket waits, empty.
scripted_lines.delivery: intimate controlled menace

scripted_lines.text: A moon behind a painted face. Some doors are only faces.
scripted_lines.delivery: intimate controlled menace

scripted_lines.text: I can hear your heart. It is very loud, in my house.
scripted_lines.delivery: intimate controlled menace

scripted_lines.text: Stay. Everyone stays. The drawbridge is only a memory of leaving.
scripted_lines.delivery: intimate controlled menace

scripted_lines.text: Eleventh night. No dawn. I hid the silver blade among the dead beneath the chapel, in a box that opens only to the marks of his claws. He will not look where he sleeps in blood.
scripted_lines.delivery: intimate controlled menace

scripted_lines.text: Thirteenth night. The Count's orrery carries a planet that does not exist, and its socket stands empty. I set the hallowed hilt there, where the brass wanders and the third moon should be.
scripted_lines.delivery: intimate controlled menace

scripted_lines.text: Fifteenth night. The portraits watch me write. One of them is a door. Behind its face I set the moonstone. If I do not return, forge all three at the chapel altar.
scripted_lines.delivery: intimate controlled menace

scripted_lines.text: I can smell your lamp oil.
scripted_lines.delivery: predatory pursuit, varied restrained and aggressive takes

scripted_lines.text: Run. The hall is very long.
scripted_lines.delivery: predatory pursuit, varied restrained and aggressive takes

scripted_lines.text: There you are.
scripted_lines.delivery: predatory pursuit, varied restrained and aggressive takes

scripted_lines.text: Ah. Found you.
scripted_lines.delivery: predatory pursuit, varied restrained and aggressive takes

scripted_lines.text: Hello again, little lamp.
scripted_lines.delivery: predatory pursuit, varied restrained and aggressive takes

scripted_lines.text: You breathe so loudly in there.
scripted_lines.delivery: predatory pursuit, varied restrained and aggressive takes

scripted_lines.text: Yes. Run. I like it when they run.
scripted_lines.delivery: predatory pursuit, varied restrained and aggressive takes
